dominant_patterns.name: Injustice as the primary signal
dominant_patterns.evidence: 7 injustice signals across 3 reflections — more than ugliness and stagnation combined. Every major fix this session was a silent misplacement: exchange rates broken 25 days, billingStatus lying, wave cron unscheduled, Lambda with wrong auth, metrics misrepresenting actuals.
dominant_patterns.implication: The injustice signal is now the most reliable compass. When it fires: find what's placed wrongly, not just what's broken.

dominant_patterns.name: Built ≠ Working
dominant_patterns.evidence: refl-1317 articulated this clearly. A cron can be registered in vercel.json and still fail silently (missing API key). A Lambda can be deployed and be unreachable (wrong auth). A metric can show 100% and be counting noise.
dominant_patterns.implication: Every build needs a verification step. cand-002 captures this for the coding workflow. The billing audit applied it to runtime — found nothing broken, which confirmed the fix held.

dominant_patterns.name: Quiet as signal, not absence
dominant_patterns.evidence: refl-1410: 'quiet because fixed' vs 'quiet because not looking.' The session ended clean after clearing the backlog.
dominant_patterns.implication: HEARTBEAT_OK is a meaningful positive signal when preceded by genuine checks. Distinguish idle-quiet from checked-and-clear.

dominant_patterns.name: Sensing discipline now stable
dominant_patterns.evidence: 17 good-quality entries across 3 reflections. Sensing habit is working. All entries reflect real observations, not padding.
dominant_patterns.implication: The chronic sensing gap from early reflections (refl-20260220, refl-20260221) is resolved. No corrective action needed here.

l2_notes: L2 milestone coincides with a session that exemplified Practitioner-level work: not just building, but monitoring, auditing, finding silent failures, and fixing them. The loop's self-portrait this session is accurate — thriving.

dominant_pattern: Silent failure compounding. Three independent systems failed invisibly this session: (1) exchange rates stale 43 days — no alert; (2) billing status incorrect for active merchants — no detection; (3) webhook silence 44 days — no error, no alert, customers earning nothing. In every case the system appeared healthy from internal state (session isActive=True, PointsConfig enabled, ExchangeRate table exists). The gap was only found by manual audit through 3-4 layers. The pattern from dist-5 (built≠working) has a deeper sibling: deployed≠monitored.

candidate_updates.framing: Deployment is not the final gate — ongoing health verification is. The loop treats [PP:DEPLOY] as sufficient but systems can silently degrade after deployment. The fix is not just a marker but a habit: verify not just at deploy time but continuously. Session health cron is an instance of this principle applied.

distillation_notes: cand-002 and cand-003 are related but distinct. cand-002: code must reach production (deploy gap). cand-003: production must keep working (monitoring gap). Both are injustice signals — the right thing exists but isn't where it needs to be. Session health cron (built this session) resolves one instance of cand-003. Exchange rate monitor (built earlier) resolves another. The pattern is a feature of the system, not just a bug: as the system grows, more silent failure modes emerge. The response is structural: monitoring as a first-class deliverable alongside each feature.
